title: REPORT on competition policy – annual report 2024
part_text: Text as a whole without the words: ‘such as the impact on workers,’
part_context: Welcomes the Draghi report’s proposal for an ‘innovation defence’ in cases where a merger increases the ability and incentive to innovate, and invites the Commission to analyse and further develop this concept; furthermore calls for matters of public interest, <del>such as the impact on workers,</del> to be taken into account;
